_comment: Copy this file to scripts/photos-process-config.json and fill in the paths. Used by strip-bg.py and composite-cards.py.
sourceFolder: G:\My Drive\Live Coverage\Race Brands\Tough Mudder\2026\Athlete Photos Source
transparentFolder: G:\My Drive\Live Coverage\Race Brands\Tough Mudder\2026\Athlete Photos
cardsFolder: G:\My Drive\Live Coverage\Race Brands\Tough Mudder\2026\Athlete Cards
_notes: sourceFolder        — raw athlete photos with backgrounds. Filename must start with bib, e.g. '56.jpg' or '56 Joseph Rucco.jpg'.
transparentFolder   — strip-bg.py writes here. Doubles as the vMix solo-stats source (build-athlete-photos.mjs manifest).
backgroundPath      — your step-and-repeat PNG; cover-fit and centred to 1080x1350.
wtmLogoPath         — transparent PNG of the WTM 2026 logo. Omit (or point at a missing file) to skip.
wtmLogoPosition     — one of top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right.
ocrLogoPath         — transparent PNG of the OCR Report logo. Same skip rules as the WTM logo.
outerFrame          — draw a rounded outer border at outerFrameInset from the edges.
outerFrameColor     — [r,g,b,a]; default is OCR Report gold #f0b400.
drawNameOnCard      — set true to render bib + name from athletesCsv onto the card. Off by default since IG captions usually carry that.
rembgModel          — 'u2net_human_seg' is tuned for people; 'birefnet-portrait' is higher quality but heavier; 'u2netp' is the fastest fallback.
